container: Video games can positively affect behavior and cognition by enhancing problem-solving skills, improving hand-eye coordination, and increasing attention span. Strategic games boost planning and decision-making abilities. However excessive gaming may lead to aggression, social withdrawal, or reduced academic performance. Balanced gameplay supports cognitive development, while moderation prevents negative outcomes. Parents and educators should encourage responsible gaming habits. Overall, video games are not inherently harmful; their impact depends on usage patterns and content.
